description: FREE. Get a live, firm quote to move funds between native XRP on the XRP Ledger and USDC or ETH on Base Mainnet (routes: XRP->USDC, XRP->ETH, USDC->XRP, ETH->XRP). Returns quote_id, exact payment instructions (amount, asset, network, pay_to, expiry), the N9T2 fee (1.45 XRP equivalent) and the estimated destination amount. Creating a quote moves no funds. Optional source_amount up to 1000 USDC / 1500 XRP / 0.5 ETH; larger transfers go to the OTC desk (boss@n9t2.com). Next: customer approves and pays in their own wallet, then call n9t2_bridge_submit_payment.

destination_address.description: Customer-controlled destination wallet: r... classic address for xrpl, 0x... address for base.
destination_address.title: Destination Address

destination_asset.description: Asset delivered: XRP on xrpl; USDC or ETH on base.
destination_asset.title: Destination Asset

destination_chain.description: Chain that receives the funds; must differ from source_chain.
destination_chain.title: Destination Chain

source_amount.description: Optional amount to bridge in the source asset as a decimal string, e.g. '250'. The N9T2 fee is added on top. Self-serve cap: 1000 USDC, 1500 XRP or 0.5 ETH. Omit for the live route minimum.
source_amount.title: Source Amount

source_asset.description: Asset the customer pays with: XRP on xrpl; USDC or ETH on base.
source_asset.title: Source Asset

source_chain.description: Chain the customer pays from: xrpl or base.
source_chain.title: Source Chain
